{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Flatpak

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  flatpak:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install Flatpak
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y flatpak flatpak-builder
          sudo flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo

      - name: Cache Flatpak runtimes
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.local/share/flatpak/repo
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-flatpak-${{ hashFiles('flatpak/io.marc.valin.yml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-flatpak-

      - name: Install Flatpak runtimes
        run: |
          flatpak install --user -y flathub org.freedesktop.Platform//24.08 org.freedesktop.Sdk//24.08
          flatpak install --user -y flathub org.freedesktop.Sdk.Extension.rust-stable//24.08

      - name: Build Flatpak and export to repo
        working-directory: flatpak
        run: |
          flatpak-builder --repo=repo --force-clean build-dir io.marc.valin.yml
          flatpak build-update-repo repo/

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: flatpak/repo

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deploy
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly downloads large Flatpak runtimes (org.freedesktop.Platform 24.08, org.freedesktop.Sdk 24.08, rust-stable extension) from flathub on every run, which is repeated dependency fetching. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads) is supported by observational evidence (ICSE 2024 workflows study, sections 4.2.1/Table 4) showing modest VM time reduction from dependency caching. Preconditions are met: repeated fetching is measurable and cache inputs can include the flatpak manifest and runner OS. Contraindications are not triggered: flathub runtimes are trusted (not mutable/untrusted) and no equivalent cache exists. The change adds a cache step for the user-level flatpak repository (~/.local/share/flatpak/repo) keyed on the manifest hash, and switches flatpak install to --user so the cache directory is user-writable and restorable by actions/cache. All original steps are preserved; no checks are removed, skipped, or weakened, and no new privileges, secrets, network targets, or deployment operations are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
